status: locked before any DEV or final run

pi_decisions_2026_09_14.affected_counties: train and inner validation on affected county-events only (event-panel peak >= 1%); test reports all, affected (conditional on realized impact) and unaffected
pi_decisions_2026_09_14.events_and_split: grouped cross-validation over the existing 26 events, stratified by type group, overlapping events in the same fold
pi_decisions_2026_09_14.asym_structure: separate damage and recovery networks; damage:recovery parameter ratio in {1:1, 2:1, 3:1} tuned on validation; NET gets the same number of structural candidates; total parameters within 1% of a common target
pi_decisions_2026_09_14.training_setup: same maximum updates, learning-rate grid and early stopping for both models; final per-seed early stopping on inner validation; both models start near persistence

data.missing_weather_counties: excluded for both models, never fed as zero
data.fit_statistics: state scale, source mean and weather standardization from each outer fold's training windows only

population.affected_rule: peak legal snapshot over the 169-hour event panel >= 0.01
population.test: all legal windows, reported as all / affected / unaffected

cross_validation.fold_rule: overlap components labelled by the type group of their event with most windows, sorted by first event date within group, round-robin over K continuing across groups in the order winter, wind_tropical, convective_flood
cross_validation.roles: outer fold k tests; fold (k+1) mod K is inner validation; the other three folds train

NET.init: output layer N(0, 1e-3), linear skip 0 (near persistence)

ASYM.form: (u, r, stay) = softmax(D(c, x_k), R(c, x_k), 0); y + u (1 - y) - r y
ASYM.init: u = 0.002 pi, r = 0.002 (1 - pi), stay = 0.998 (near persistence)

training.loss: full-path squared error scaled by the fold fit scale; no teacher forcing
training.sampler: uniform event, then county, then origin over training windows; identical batch ids for NET and ASYM at the same fold and seed

selection.rule: per outer fold and model: lowest mean over DEV seeds of the best inner-validation path MSE; ties -> smaller lr, then structure order
selection.lock: locks/SELECTION_LOCK.json, committed before any final run

evaluation.weighting: per seed squared loss first; within event counties equal, origins equal within county, leads equal; event-equal across events
evaluation.inference_unit: overlap component (within a grouping, only that grouping's events)
evaluation.signflip: exact up to 16 components, Monte Carlo 200000 draws above
evaluation.decision: supports ASYM if p < 0.05 and event-equal and component-mean Delta both positive; supports NET if p < 0.05 and both negative; otherwise undecided
evaluation.secondary_metric: event RMSE = sqrt(event path MSE) per seed; event-equal RMSE, NET minus ASYM and a component sign-flip p; never used for training, selection or the decision
